command:
cat > /tmp/gdbargs.cmd <<'EOF'
set pagination off
set confirm off
set architecture riscv:rv64
set language rust
target remote localhost:1234
break os::mm::page_table::PageTable::map
continue
info args
print vpn
print ppn
print flags
p vpn.0
p ppn.0
p/x flags.bits
quit
EOF
/tmp/gdbrun.sh /tmp/gdbargs.cmd 90 2>&1 | tail -25; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
